title: Ravita Engineering Services IPO Details
intro:
Ravita Engineering Services IPO is a book build issue of ₹116.05 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.04 crore shares of ₹116.05 crore.

Ravita Engineering Services IPO opens for subscription on Oct 13, 2026 and closes on Oct 15, 2026. The allotment for the Ravita Engineering Services IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 16, 2026. Ravita Engineering Services IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 21, 2026.

Ravita Engineering Services IPO is set issue price band at ₹105 to ₹112 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,68,800 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,03,200.

Vivro Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Pace Stock Broking Services Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Ravita Engineering Services IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in December 2007, Ravita Engineering Services Limited is an engineering solutions company engaged in Engineering, Procurement, Installation and Commissioning (EPIC) of HVAC systems, central air-conditioning solutions, air flow systems, chiller plants, industrial compressors, cooling equipment and other electromechanical equipment on a turnkey basis. The Company also provides Operations and Maintenance (O&M) services for projects executed by it and systems installed by third-party solution providers.The Company operates across three areas: Onshore, Offshore and Data Center. Its Onshore operations cover commercial, hospitality, corporate and industrial establishments, while its Offshore operations include rigs, platforms and other offshore marine installations.

During the last three fiscal years and the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Company undertook operations at 6 rigs and 16 associated offshore oil and gas platforms. Its Data Center business provides O&M services for cooling systems, chiller plants, HVAC equipment and mechanical utilities, and it has also secured data center infrastructure work orders aggregating ₹12,000.00 lakhs in Maharashtra.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had an order book across its Onshore, Offshore and Data Center operations, comprising EPIC, O&M and Hybrid projects. The Company is led by Vibhoar Agrawal, Chairman and Executive Director, and Sunildutt Narayan Goswami, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, supported by its Chief Operating Officer and engineering and execution teams.

The Company's revenue from operations increased from ₹1,349.25 lakhs in Fiscal 2024 to ₹27,763.29 lakhs in Fiscal 2026, while EBITDA increased to ₹4,004.92 lakhs and profit after tax stood at ₹2,804.16 lakhs in Fiscal 2026.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 399 permanent employees, including 369 in site operations.
strengths: Balanced EPIC and O&M business model.
Specialised experience in offshore and data center operations.

faqs.question: How to apply in Ravita Engineering Services IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Ravita Engineering Services IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Ravita Engineering Services IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Ravita Engineering Services IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Ravita Engineering Services IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Ravita Engineering Services IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Ravita Engineering Services IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Ravita Engineering Services IPO will be done on Friday, October 16, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Oct 19, 2026 . Check the Ravita Engineering Services IPO allotment status .
